queries.result: Found the Geoportal Philippines official map portal and a DENR Region III Land Management Service cadastral-information listing that names a Cabanatuan land-information map (CAD-051). No public parcel-feature endpoint was established.

source.name: DENR Region III Land Management Service Cadastre Information System / Geoportal Philippines
source.custodian: DENR Region III Land Management Service is named by the cadastral-information listing; Geoportal Philippines is the national geospatial portal.
source.cityEvidence: The cadastral listing contains Cabanatuan.tif with survey number CAD-051 and labels the section DENR R3 - Land Management Service (LMS).

attempts.outcome: Succeeded; official/named source leads found, but no parcel API identified.
HTTP 200; page listed Cabanatuan.tif, survey CAD-051, as a Land Information Map.
HTTP 406 Not Acceptable; no image or geometry response was usable. This is a service/request failure, not evidence of no cadastral coverage.

attempts.route: Geoportal Philippines public HTML and JavaScript/config inspection
attempts.outcome: HTTP 200; public OpenLayers viewer exposes layer-download and EPSG lookup routes. The advertised public inventory is not a verified parcel feature response.
HTTP 200 JSON; returned 12 agency sectors. No parcel feature query was made.
HTTP 500 because the guessed layer name `parcel` is not a database relation. This does not establish a parcel layer or city coverage.
HTTP 200 PDF download; inventory was retained only in ignored scratch evidence and no unsafe records were requested.

HTTP 200; UI advertises parcel-map filtering and GeoJSON download, but the page requires interactive layer state/sign-in paths and yielded no bounded Cabanatuan parcel response in this anonymous pass.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: A DENR Region III cadastral-information listing documents a Cabanatuan land-information map; Geoportal Philippines documents national geospatial layers. Neither was verified here as an anonymous citywide parcel polygon service.

qualityAssessment.identityReadiness: not ready; no safe native parcel identity was returned by an accessible public feature service
qualityAssessment.attributesRequested: none; no owner, address, titleholder, tax/account, contact, or personal fields requested

blocker: No anonymous, bounded parcel ID-plus-geometry response was verified. The named Cabanatuan cadastral map returned HTTP 406, and Geoportal/PGAS routes did not produce a parcel feature response.
remainingUncertainty: The official/named DENR R3 listing supports existence of cadastral map material for Cabanatuan, but its raster contents, CRS, parcel identities, and citywide machine-readable coverage remain unverified. An exact WUP-point hit was not attempted because no usable parcel endpoint was available; no absence inference is made.
nextStep: Retry the Cabanatuan CAD-051 source when its image endpoint accepts an ordinary public request, or identify a documented DENR/Geoportal parcel feature service and validate a small geometry-only sample with native IDs before adapter review.
identityPolicy: No retained sample; if later geometry is obtained, retain exactly one stable native parcel identity per feature and keep source field mapping in metadata.
